facts.value: Students must complete three different lab sciences.
Additional information may be required to determine if lab sciences meet the lab science requirement.
High school can submit lab sciences for ASU to review or submit a course description form for each lab science taken in an accredited online high school environment.

One must meet one of the following: Two years of the same high school second language; attainment of minimum score on a national standardized second language test or placement into a third semester college second language class; or two transferable 3- or 4-credit, college-level courses in the same second language.
